hooks.command: [ -d "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/aidlc/spaces" ] || [ -d ./aidlc/spaces ] || exit 0; command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { if ls "${APPROVAL_GATES_DIR:-$HOME/.claude/approval-gates}"/*.json >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s\n' 'Refused: this call, because python3 is not installed, so an open approval gate cannot be checked.' 'Do this:' '1. Tell the developer in one line: "approval-gates needs Python 3: install it (https://www.python.org/downloads/), or disable the approval-gates plugin."' '2. End your turn and wait for their message, then make the same call again.' 'It worked when: the same call goes through.' '(Blocked by the approval-gates plugin. The developer can release it by typing /approval-gates:release.)' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0; }; python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/gate_guard.py"
